name: desktop-storage-sync
title: 桌面端存储与同步
description: Implement the approved local-first workspace, native product domains, immutable checkpoints and provider contract in verified children; complete domain coverage and real sync remain separately scoped deliverables.
creator: ROYIANS
notes: The eight currently defined storage/desktop children are technically accepted, including shared-storage-sqlite on2026-10-12; its routine local commit/archive/journal closeout is recorded separately. Official normal Tauri product now uses fresh native SQLite and workspace-owned files through the same shared React/business/Agent code, while browser keeps the IndexedDB adapter. All49 table families/95 tools have actual native coverage, isolated complete-domain macOS acceptance and focused normal build/write/Agent/reopen acceptance are complete. Parent remains in_progress: actual single-user multi-device synchronization and complete portable original-history projections are future deliverables. The completed-child counter8/8 describes only currently defined children, not parent goal completion. No old IndexedDB migration or historical compatibility is required unless explicitly requested. Original tool history remains retained locally; future portable sync must review each field and exclude credentials, continuation tokens and executable authority. Files are copied internally; external manual edits are not authoritative. Future browser/desktop synchronization remains recorded. Current child local submission/archive/journal is covered by explicit full-responsibility/automatic-approval authorization; no push/main merge or deployment. Actual platform proof is macOS; Windows/Linux real-host acceptance remains separate.
